about.title: Built lean, on purpose.
paragraphs: I'm Kaden Ekuma Bokome, an independent web and systems builder based in Hampshire, UK.
Most small and mid-sized businesses get stuck between two bad options: cheap templates that look generic and convert poorly, or agencies charging £10,000+ for three months of meetings.
Zelux sits between the two. A site designed for your business and built to load fast, with the admin around it automated where that saves real time. You deal with me from the first call to launch.

fixedQuote.title: One fixed price. Agreed before work starts.
fixedQuote.body: Every build is quoted as a fixed project fee within 48 hours of our intro call. No day rates, no surprise invoices, and no VAT charged, so the number you see is the number you pay.

guide.title: Clear, fixed-scope pricing.
guide.body: Bespoke websites start from £900 (no VAT charged), with optional rolling monthly care after launch. Automation builds are scoped to size after a 20-minute call.

closing.title: Ready to get it built?
closing.body: Book a 20-minute call. Tell me what you're trying to fix or launch, and I'll tell you plainly if I can help.
